correctness.rationale: For n>=2 and 1<=d<n, b:x↦x+1 mod n and a:0↦d (other states fixed). A common reset image requires x+B+dK_x constant mod n; gcd(n,d)>1 preserves initial difference modulo gcd and forbids synchronization. When gcd=1, effective-a counts K_x occupy all n residues mod n, forcing a trajectory with >=n-1 jumps and >=(n-2)(n-d) intervening b letters, giving |w| >=1+(n-2)(n-d+1). T=ab^(n-d) fixes 0 and subtracts d from other states; T^(n-2)a attains the bound. Equality leaves no spare a/b and forces the literal word a(b^(n-d)a)^(n-2), including n=2. Fresh subset-automaton BFS independently compared all 45 cases n=2..10 and shortest multiplicities (and noncoprime failures). Finite checks corroborate only finite n, proof supplies general n.
residual_risks: Finite tests cannot prove all-parameter claim; proof reconstruction establishes stated scope.
